description: Named repeatable Phase 0 performance scenarios for PUMO PUMO !
targetBuild: production Electron package (npm run build:electron). Dev/Vite is not a valid FPS baseline.
enableInstrumentation: Launch with ?perf=1 or localStorage.setItem('pumo_perf','1') then reload. Overlay: Ctrl+Shift+P. Dump: window.__PUMO_PERF.dump()

scenarios.name: Idle match for five minutes
steps: Start a local VS CPU or training match with toppers equipped
Do not input after Hakkiyoi
Record frame times, heap, cache bytes, active particles for 5 minutes

scenarios.name: Continuous movement and dashing
steps: Both fighters move and dash continuously
Avoid heavy particle spam

scenarios.name: FLAP + slide-jump transition torture
steps: Rapidly repeat: slide → slide jump → FLAP1 → FLAP2 → recovery → idle → hit interrupt → land → FLAP again
Run with every head gear id and representative mawashi/body/tint combos
Enable GhostFrameTracer; assert zero pose/cosmetic tuple mismatches

scenarios.name: Both players wearing toppers
steps: Equip distinct toppers on P1 and P2
Play normal combat including FLAP

scenarios.name: Rapid hit/parry/charge effects
steps: Spam slap/parry/charge interactions

scenarios.name: Maximum particle stress
steps: Trigger overlapping impact/kill/trail emitters

scenarios.name: Cinematic kill
steps: Force charged kill cinematics repeatedly

scenarios.name: 20 rematches
steps: Complete or skip to rematch 20 times
Snapshot memory/cache after each rematch

scenarios.name: 50 BASHO bouts / color changes
steps: Advance through BASHO with frequent opponent/color changes
Watch for prior-fighter color ghosts and unbounded pin growth

scenarios.name: Leave inactive then return
steps: Start match, hide tab or blur window for the variant duration
Return and immediately fight / FLAP
Record rewarm overlap, decode storm duration, first-playable-frame readiness

scenarios.name: Minimize and restore Electron
steps: Packaged Electron only
Minimize for 60s, restore, fight immediately

scenarios.name: Network latency/jitter/loss
steps: Online 1v1 with 20/50/100/150/250ms latency, jitter, loss, reorder
Phase 0: capture packet rates/handler times only; structural packet changes are Phase 5

scenarios.name: Steam Deck-class / low-mid iGPU
steps: Repeat flap-slide-jump-torture + particle-stress on target hardware
Document exceptions vs desktop baseline

scenarios.name: Hidden-tab preload deadlock repro
steps: Start prematch preload
Immediately hide the tab/window before Step 6 completes
Observe whether spritesReady/isLoading stalls until visible
PerfRecorder marks preload.step6 visibility + wall clock
